title: Geospatial Data Scientist
description: Analyze satellite imagery, geographic information systems (GIS), spatial point patterns, and remote sensing telemetry with Python and spatial databases.

goal.objective: Extract predictive geospatial intelligence from satellite imagery, urban mobility patterns, and environmental sensor networks.

learn.summary: Master spatial libraries (GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, GDAL), PostGIS spatial indexing (R-Tree), satellite remote sensing (Sentinel, Landsat), and spatial ML.
key_competencies: Raster Data Processing with Rasterio & GDAL
Web Mapping with Mapbox GL & Leaflet
prerequisites: Basic understanding of cartography and coordinates (CRS)

capstone_projects.title: Satellite-Based Urban Deforestation & Wildfire Risk Mapping Engine
capstone_projects.description: Process multi-spectral Sentinel-2 imagery computing NDVI and thermal indices to predict wildfire risk corridors with sub-10m spatial resolution.

capstone_projects.title: Urban Mobility & Transit Isochrone Optimization Network
capstone_projects.description: Engineer an urban transit accessibility model utilizing Uber H3 hexagonal spatial indexing, computing real-time travel-time isochrones across multimodal transit.

interview_focus: Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS), Geographic vs Projected (EPSG:4326 vs EPSG:3857)
Vector vs Raster Data Operations (Zonal Statistics, Buffer, Intersect, Map Algebra)
Spatial Indexing Algorithms (R-Tree, QuadTree, Geohash, Uber H3 Hexagonal Grid)
PostGIS Spatial Queries (ST_Intersects, ST_DWithin, Spatial Joins & Index Tuning)
Handling Massive Remote Sensing Datasets with Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COG) & STAC API
